tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one static full-body creature master proposal for a game sprite; Dread Knight, upgraded CBLORD.
Primary request: faithfully redraw the actual mounted unit in Image 1 with the fine modeled-volume rendering and material finish of Image 4. Produce exactly ONE horse and its ONE seated rider, isolated together on genuine transparency. This is a rendering translation of the native idle, not a redesign.
Input images: Image 1 native-idle-6x.png is the definitive identity, proportions, pose, silhouette and original RIGHT-facing reference. Image 2 native-g02-guide.png confirms the idle from start/middle/end samples. Image 3 native-g12-guide.png clarifies the single curved sword and armor only; DO NOT adopt its attack poses. Image 4 pikeman-rendering-master.png supplies fine sculptural shading and surface rendering ONLY, never costume, weapon, pose or colors. Do not reproduce reference labels or multiple figures.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, no environment, no floor, no ground-contact or cast shadow, no backdrop color and no checkerboard painted into the image.
Subject and pose: preserve the compact, tall mounted silhouette of Image 1, approximately width:height 83:99. Preserve the original slightly three-quarter side view facing screen RIGHT, upright rider, horse head position, compact horse torso, planted staggered legs and hooves, hanging rider leg, black tail and source saddle placement. The horse is dark-coated, fully living equine anatomy beneath armor, with the same proportions as the source; no skeletal mount. Both helmet top and all four hooves, tail, sword tip and armor spikes must fit with generous transparent margins. Do not broaden or lengthen the horse, inflate the rider or turn the unit into a front view. Native idle only, no rearing or attacking.
Identity and costume: CBLORD's narrow tall straight-sided enclosed steel helm, slim red horizontal visor slit, restrained metallic rim and BLACK trailing crest/plume exactly as the source. NO large horns on the helmet. Dark blue-black fitted plate armor on the rider with concentrated pale silver highlights, clearly visible pale metal shoulder spikes in the original positions, silver articulated arm and leg details. Keep the characteristic bright silver-gray horse face/neck/chest barding, projecting pale metal spikes on the front face armor, source leg armor and small metal bands. Preserve the red saddle fabric panels and hanging red fringe beneath the barding, restrained red accents and dark leather tack. Horse barding and shoulder spikes distinguish this upgrade from the unarmored-horse CBKNIG; do not omit or replace them. Use the exact reference construction instead of generic death-knight horn armor, skull decorations or an invented costume.
Weapon: exactly ONE low curved SILVER sword in the visible hand, hilt beside the rider's hip, sweeping downward across the near side of the horse's chest with its thin curved tip pointing RIGHT, precisely the idle placement in Image 1. Natural gauntlet grip, physically connected continuous blade, modest brass-toned hilt as in the source. No shield, lance, second blade or raised weapon.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted game character render with small nuanced tonal transitions and fine modeled volume, crisp controlled silhouette and readable steel highlights, like the Pikeman rendering reference. Detailed but restrained leather, metal and red cloth. Preserve the blue-black versus pale steel material separation. No blocky pixel clusters, cartoon outlines, chibi proportions, enlarged pauldrons or photoreal scene treatment.
Lighting/mood: restrained directional light that describes the existing volumes; dark menacing character with readable armor. Red visor is a small color accent only, no emitted light or bloom.
Composition/framing: one complete single static mounted unit, centered in a square transparent canvas with at least 10 percent clear margin around the entire silhouette. High resolution clean cutout for later uniform mechanical registration into a 1024x768 review cell. Do not force the whole mounted unit to 180 pixels; the downstream shared source scale is 180/73 and native 99-pixel mounted height maps to approximately 244 pixels.
Constraints: no new effects, particles, aura, smoke, flames, red magical overlays, floor, shadow, base, text, labels, border, watermark or extra props. Preserve the native CBLORD idle, facing, proportions, equipment and upgrade identity. This call creates only the static master, no animation frames or sheet.
